tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// tridhwatwākarṣaṣasyāṅkushaṃnāmashwetanāthashtsīntāmaṇessādhanānudzñāshtsasahauwarṇaṇobidzaharaṃ//

༄༅// mgon po dkar po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug dpal stug sras dang bcas// ji snyed ma tshang med par yongs 'dus zhal// dran pas srid zhi'i dpal 'jo bla ma dang*// zung min mgon po yid bzhin nor bus skyongs// gang gi thugs rje'i 'dab stong dgod pa las// thun mong mchog dngos 'dzad med ro bda'i dpal// nyer 'dren sgrub thabs rjes gnang bung ba'i glu// skal bzang legs bris gzhon nu'i sgra 'dzin dpyid// 'phags yul grub dbang mkhyen rab mtha' med kyi// ral pa las brgyud mkhas grub khyung po yi// dka' spyad bha gi ra thas nyer phab klung*// dngos grub rin chen rdul phreng 'dren pa brtsam// de'ang thog mar 'di'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro spyi ltar ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying gi dkyil du thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam pa/ de'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu cig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus de gnyis la thim/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pa las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig 'dzum zhing khro ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu/

gsum pas ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa'i nang bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba brla g.yon la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas lcags kyu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon pa 'dra ba/ 'byon 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na tshogs bdag la phug dang ne'u le bzung ba re re mnan pa'i kha dang bshang lam thams cad nas rin po che lhug lhug 'ong ba/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nge ba/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa cig tu gyur/ de'i snying gar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar dang*/ oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du shabda/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparṣe rnams kyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ mtheb srin gyis 'thor ba'i tshul dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang rang gis myang*/

'khor gyi mkha' 'gro nor sbyin rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod la/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po'i mthar rtsa sngags bye ru'i phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can grangs med pa 'phros pas/ srid zhi'i dge legs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas thig le la thim par bsams la/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ yang 'od zer sngar bzhin 'phros/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ srid pa gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad ril gyis bsdus nas rang gi mdun du zas nor longs spyod ri rab tsam spungs par bsam/ khyad par stobs 'byor che dgu thams cad kyi snying du 'od zer mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi rim pa dang bcas pas zhugs/ de dag gi rgyud rang dbang med par bskul nas bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam/ khyad par dmigs yul gyi snying dkyil rnam shes nṛ ljang gu nya mig tsam yod pa/ mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tsir gyis bzung nas bdag gi dbang du byas par bsam pa ni mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin la brten pa'i zab khyad do// bzlas pa'i mjug tu gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de dag ni bskyed rim mo// de nas nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid gdan dang bcas pa snying ga'i mkha' 'gro ma la/ de sngags phreng la/ de thig le la/ de hūm̐ yig la/ de yang nā da'i bar du thim/ de yang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la ci tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par 'jog bzhag pa'i ngang la rig pa de rig stong*/ 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong*/ ma sgrib par gsal ba de gsal stong*/ yin min gyi mtha' dang bral bas rmi lam gyi snang ba/

sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes ngo sprod pa ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// zhes shangs pa du gu pa bzhed do// slar yang de'i ngang nas lha yi skur ldangs la gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ram/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag yid bzhin nor bu 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ thun mtshams sa gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma la dpal bshos sam yang na zlum gtor dkar po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ rtse mor mgon po'i tsa ka li dang*/ mar gyi nor bu'i gzugs sogs rgyan ldan/ mtheb kyu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba/ bu ram sogs zas snas bkang ba/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma/ mdun du nyer spyod bcas bshams la/ gtor ma nang mchod chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me dang*/ mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrūm̐ ām̐ dzṝṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga rnams mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ bsdu na sngags 'di kho nas byin rlabs byas kyang rung ngo*// mdun bskyed rgyas pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/ de yongs su gyur pa las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs nas gnyis su med par thim pa'i bar 'dra bar byas/ bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drangs/ gtor sngags rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa la i daṃ ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad dkar 'chang*// 'gro 'di'i phun tshogs re ba skong ba'i phyir// rab brjid khro bo'i dbang por sprul pa la// yid bzhin nor bu mtshan gsol khyod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor pa'i// tshe bsring longs spyod rgyas pa dang*// skye 'gro dbang du 'du bar mdzod// ces dang spro na/

bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gzi ldan thugs rje can khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod cig dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs shig bla ma'i sku tshe srings shig rnal 'byor bdag la snyan pa'i grags pas sa stengs ma lus par khyab pa dang*/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs nas longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang*/ mi nor zas gsum 'du zhing*/ thos bsam bsgom gsum 'phel ba dang*/ phrin las 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di ni bdag mdun gang yin gyi skabs su yang 'dis gsol ba gdab pa ni gnad do gsung ngo*// de nas rten la brtan bzhugs byas nas gnas bsrung dge ba bsngo ba bkra shis gang shes bya'o// gong gi nyer bsdu zhes pa'i rdzogs rim skabs 'dir bsgom kyang rung bas gang mos bya'o// spyod lam gyi gnas skabs kun du snang grag rig gsum thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam rol du shes pa'i dran pa ma brjed par bya ba gal che/ 'grub pa'i rtags dang yon tan thams cad mi bslu ba 'byung ba ni nges pa nyid do// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs bu rten khebs la sogs pas bkab par me tog gi sil ma bkram pa'i steng du/ 'di'i gtor ma zan dras zlum po'i steng du nor bu mig gsum pa'i steng 'dzam bshos kyi dbyibs can la mar gyi rtse rgyan nyi zla nor bu la sogs pas brgyan pa dar dkar gyi gur dang ldan pa gzhag de'i mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po gnyis dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod sogs 'og tu mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par bya'o// gnyis pa ni mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ dharm+ma ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mjug tu gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa'i bar gong ltar nyams su blang ngo*// de nas mdun gyi gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/ de yongs su gyur pa las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs nas gnyis su med par thim pa'i bar gyis gtor ma mgon dkar du bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas la/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra re re sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ rtsa sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos sogs kyis bstod/ 'bul gtor sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am bsdu na 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te gong ltar phul la mchod bstod dang gsol gdab ji ltar rigs pa byas/ gtor ma gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar 'bul lo// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu byas nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs ji ltar rigs pa byas/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i zlos gar/ myur mdzad mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu phyag drug pa ste/ de la zhi ba nor du sgrub pa dang drag po mthu ru sgrub pa ste gnyis las/ 'di nyid snga ma ste de'ang gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa stsol zhing dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang*/

mthar thug bla na med pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu ster ba'i gdams pa khyad par can grub chen rā hu las mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la man ngag sgo skyel gyi tshul du gnang ba'i mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ de'ang sngon gyi lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma mai tri pa ko sa bikṣa'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ grub chen rā hu las gser srang bdun phul nas/ bod 'di longs spyod chung bas/ nor sgrub myur la rtags mtshan che ba'i gdams pa cig zhu zhus pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mgon po zhes kyang bya/ shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsandan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya ba 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung*/ dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag par byed pa la bzlog pas mi tshugs pa/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub lo zlas 'grub pa/ mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba/ thun mong sgrub pas mchog zhar las 'byung ba cig yod pa de khyod la sbyin gsung ngo*// de bla ma la zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mgon po 'dis thugs bskyed pa'i tshul gsungs pa/ sngon gyi dus su sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar thugs rje chen pos sems bskyed de/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di stongs par ma gyur bar du bdag mya ngan las mi 'da' bar sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig gal te bdag sems bskyed 'di nyams par gyur na mgo bo tshal pa stong du 'gas par gyur cig ces brjod nas dam bcas te/ ri bo po tā lar nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems can rnams la ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug cing*/ gang la gang 'dul gyis lo grangs dpag tu med par sems can gyi don byas te mthar sems can gyi khams phal cher grol ba byung las che snyam nas gzigs pas/

sems can gyi khams la 'grib pa med pa'i steng du/ snyigs mar song bas nyon mongs pa rags pa gdug pa cher song ba gzigs pa dang*/ da ni bdag gis sems can re 'ga' tsam yang bsgral bar mi nus par 'dug snyam nas/ sems bskyed btang ba dang dbu tshal pa stong du gas par gyur to// de'i tshe sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas byon nas/ rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems bskyed las gzhol ba ni shin tu ma legs pas de'i bshags pa la sngar las rgya che ba zhig gi sems bskyed cig gsungs nas/ dbu tshal pa stong du gas pa dbu bcu dang de'i gong du sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu yod pa dang bcas pa'i zhal bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlab bo// de'i tshe thugs rje chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ da sngar gyi sems bskyed de'i cha gcig kyang ngas ma nus/ de bas rgya che ba zhig kyang med na ji ltar bgyi snyam nas zhag bdun brgyal bar gyur to// de nas brgyal ba de sangs pa dang*/ da ni snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung la bar chad mang ba/ rkyen dbang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba/ longs spyod chung zhing 'tsho ba dman pa/ sgrub long med par bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro ba/ dam tshig mi bsrung zhing bzlog pa dang nang dme byed pa/ chos byed phal cher yang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar ba gzigs nas/ yun ring por bsgrub mi dgos par zhal mthong ba/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig gis brlag par byed pa/ mchog dang thun mong lo zlas 'grub pa'i dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i khro bor gyur nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam du dgongs te/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag cig phyung de las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur gyur pa dang sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so// de'i tshe sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa mgrin gcig tu bsdebs te/

rigs kyi bu sems can re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i spyod pa 'di shin tu legs so// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed pos phrin las 'di nyid mthu dang ldan par bya'o// gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dbang gi rang bzhin gyis dbang dang ldan par bya'o// de nyid kyis zhi ba dang rgyas par yang 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi phrin las su sprul pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dang gshin rje dang srin po dang*/ ma mo dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang las sna tshogs bsgrub par 'gyur ro// de nyid tshul bzhin du sgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ dran pas dngos grub ma lus pa ster bar 'gyur ro// bsgrub pa nyid nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ de nyid kyis dngos su zhal ston par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan byin gyis brlabs shing bka' bsgo bar mdzad do// des na ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid bsgrubs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub cig car du stsol bas khyad par 'phags shing byin rlabs dngos grub shin tu myur ba yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/ lo rgyus 'di dag mi spro na ma brjod kyang chog de la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa/ slob dpon la mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dngos yin snyam pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya ba rnams sngon 'gro yin/ rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon mgon dkar du gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rnams bcom ldan 'das mgon po yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa nas thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gsal gdab/ de nas dngos gzhi sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma gnyis ka mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran pa'i dbang gis mgon po yid bzhin nor bu nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir byon/ de rnams las de 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang rnams mgon dkar du gsal ba'i sku lus la sib kyis thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ.ā we sha ya aḥzhes lan gsum mam lnga brjod cing rol chen bya zhing gu gul gyis bdug de ni sku'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon mdun bskyed gnyis ka mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge a ā i ī nas aṃ aḥzhes pa'i ā li dang*/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha zhes pa nas ha kṣa zhes pa'i kā li dang*/ khyad par ye shes mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad chos skyong spyi'i sngags oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na sogs nas hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ mgon dkar 'di nyid kyi sngags gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dkar po rang sgra sgrogs bzhin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas khyed rang rnams mgon dkar du gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas sib kyis thim/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la gu ru ma hā kā la sogs sngar bzhin brjod cing rol chen dang spos dud bya/ de ni gsung gi rjes su gnang ba yin/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka mgon dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ khyad par ye shes mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad rnam pa gri gug dang yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa la sems cher cig gtad pas/ de rnams 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams mgon dkar du gsal ba'i snying ga nas sib kyis thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang sngags sngar bzhin brjod cing rol chen dang spos dud bya/ de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/

yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon mgon dkar du gsal ba dang mdun bskyed kyi mgon dkar gnyis ka'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas lcags kyu g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nge ba spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa re lam gyis gsal btab pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi zas nor bcud g.yang la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas khyed rang rnams la sib kyis thim pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang sngags sngar bzhin brjod cing rol chen dang spos dud bya/ de nas bzlas lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng dang po gnyis pa gsum pa rnams chad/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod ces dang sngags kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar rjes zlos byas nas slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu bzhag pas/ sngags kyi dngos grub myur du thob pa'i skal ba can du byas snyam du mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ slob ma'i mgo bor me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sku gsung thugs/ gsang sngags rig sngags kyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces brjod/

de nas gtor ma mgon dkar du gsal ba slob ma'i mgo thog tu spyan drangs te bka' bsgo ba ni/ gu ru ma hā kā la nas dzaḥs ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dpal ldan sha wa ri/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gupta badzra/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan/ pu rang dpal ldan dar po/ zhi dgon pa rje bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen dam pa 'gyur med bde chen/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan/ khams ston sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod/ rdo rje slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la 'go zhing 'ches pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams kyis dam pa'i chos sgrub par byed pa'i dus su 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor dang snyan grags dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar bsgom pas khyed rang gi spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i mgon dkar 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas gnyis su med par thim nas mgon po lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/

rtag tu srung skyob mdzad pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang maṇḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ 'bul gtor steng du 'bul/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod cing ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed rang la bstims nas dge rtsa sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o// smras pa/ 'phags yul rin chen gling nas rā hu las// gdams ngag 'dod 'byung nor bu legs blangs nas// gangs can bstan 'gro'i dbul ba dbrog slad du// grub dbang khyung po'i thugs gsang dpal ber sbas// yid bzhin nor mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug gi /zhal lung gtsor brten sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// yi ge yid ches sum ldan khams gsum dpal// yongs 'gugs padma rā ga'i lcags kyu 'di// 'bad par lhur blangs dge bas stobs bcu pa'i// dgongs pa 'chad mkhas bstan pa 'dzam bu'i gling*// byams bstan ma shar de srid ches bdo bas// ris bral sems can phan par byed gyur cig /ces mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa'i yi ge khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni chos rje bkra shis dpal bzang po sogs don gnyer dag gis bskul ngor/ 'di skor la bla ma so sos mdzad pa'i lha bskyed dur khrod rgyan chas sogs phyag drug nag po'i par bkab kyi spros pa mang du mchis mod/ mkhas grub khyung pos mdzad pa'i gzhung dri ma med pa nyid gtsor bzung*/ de dang mthun shas che ba mkhan chen ngag chos pa dang bstan 'dzin phrin las pa sogs mkhas grub mang po'i gsung rab dang rjes gnang gi phyag len gang las mnos pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nyams su bstar bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sbyar ba 'gro ba thams cad la phan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// dpag bsam nor bu bum pa bzang ji bzhin// bsam kun rdzogs pa'i dngos grub char che ba// mgon po 'char ka'i zla ba gtsug brten nas// gter bum man ngag 'grel la gnang ba stsol// de la 'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud nas brgyud pa'i mgon dkar gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ 'di'i gter bum sgrub pa'i tshul la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes te gsum las/ dang po bum pa gsar pa/ ma spyad pa/ gas chag med pa/ yul gyi bre tshad las mi chung ba dkar rtsis byugs pa/ mdun rtags mchu'am bkra shis rtags kyi ri mos mdzes pa/ de'i nang du nas dkar mo sad ser 'bu srin gyis zos pa'i skyon med pa dang*/ bra sran sa rdo ma 'dres pa'i 'bras gro rnams phyug po'i bang mdzod nas byung ba'am/ ma 'byor na gzhan yang rung zhing*/ gzhan yang bum rdzas rin po che sna tshogs/ a ru ra gser mdog dang bzang drug dang bum rdzas nyer lnga sogs sman sna tshogs/ gos dar dang ras sna tshogs kyi ras ma/ rgya ja'i rigs/ sha mar/ mngar gsum/ shing thog gi rigs/ bkra shis pa'i sa sna chu sna rta phyugs kyi spu la sogs pa 'byor tshad kyis khengs par bkang*/ de'i nang lto ba'i stod tsam du mgon dkar gyi sku gzugs rab gnas can zhal mdun du bstan pa dang*/ rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa'i mjug tu/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs sogs 'og gi brtan bzhugs kyi tshig rnams shog bu la gser dngul mtshal gang 'byor gyis dbu can du bris par ga pur/ gur gum/ tsandan dmar po/ rang byung*/ gi wang sogs kyis byugs pa dbu nas bsgril ba/ mgo mjug mi log par byas te/ sku gzugs kyi phyogs bzhi'am gang bder bzhugs su gsol/ sngar gyi 'bru sna la sogs pas mi 'khrul bar 'thas par brdzongs la/

lug dar ma'i sog pa g.yas pa'i bal rtsi med pas kha nas bkab/ de'i steng rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i kha 'gebs kyis kha bkab/ tshon sna lnga'i skud pas mgrin pa bcings pa'i lhag mas kha 'gebs kyi steng nas rgya gram du bsdam/ de dang mnyam du dbang gi 'khor lo sgrub na/ 'khor lo man ngag ltar bris pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas byas nas bltabs te skud pa dmar pos dkris pa/ sgrub pa'i tshe bum pa'i mgul bar btags la bzhag go /de lta bu'i bum pa mang po yod na lhan cig tu sgrub ste/ bum pa rnams me tog gis bkram pa'i stegs kyi khar bzhag la gzungs thag gis sbrel/ de'i mdun du snod yangs shing gas chag med par mgon po'i 'bul gtor cog zlum che ba mtheb kyus bskor ba la mar rgyan nyi zla nor bus mtshan pa/ de'i g.yas su mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin/ g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams bu ram sogs zas snas brgyan pa dang*/ mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod bsham/ sgrub po'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bla med spyi ltar byin rlabs byas nas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor mgon dkar du bsgom/ mdun bskyed la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor zhing*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta dang swa bhā wa'i sngags gnyis kyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rin po che dang 'bru bcud dang*/ zas nor longs spyod lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur par bsams la/ tshig lhug rnams med pa'i sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab cing rgyas par spel/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i nang stod kyi cha la hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i sogs nas/

chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ 'khor du mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ yang 'khor lo rnams bsang sbyangs/ 'khor lo rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i hūm̐ dkar po dwangs pa'i sogs nas dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur ces pa'i bar gyis 'khor lo bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas 'khor lo dang bum pa'i lha rnams la gnyis su med par bstim/ mchod pa byin rlabs bla med spyi ltar byas/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas/ sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rtsa sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang*/ bstod pa gang rung gis bstod/ gtor ma bsang ba nas/ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum par gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// gtor ma gzhan thams cad mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas 'bul lo// de nas me tog thogs la/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rten 'di dag la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas gnas 'dir mkhyen ldan dang stobs ldan 'byor ldan gyis mtshon pa'i skye 'gro thams cad 'du zhing*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha sogs kyis me tog 'thor/ de lta bu'i brtan bzhugs 'di nyer gcig gam lnga bcu'am brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar ci nus su bya bar bshad do// de nas gzungs thag bzung la rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer sngags phreng gi rnam pa can spros pas bskul/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po rnams kyi thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams las/ de 'dra ba'i dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ lha mi klu dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ stobs dang dpal 'byor/ longs spyod dbang phyug snyan grags/ rigs bzang*/ rin po che dang*/ 'bru rigs dang*/ rta phyugs 'phel ba la sogs pa 'byor pa'i khyad par yid la ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad bkug ste/ bum pa'i nang rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par bstims pas 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang por gyur/ bum pa'i nang gi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams rab tu rgyas shing kha nas lud/ mgon po'i phyag gi bum pa dang thod pa nas kyang lud/ tshogs bdag gi kha dang bshang lam dang ne'u le rnams las kyang rin po che sna tshogs pa lhug lhug babs pas gnas khang dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ pho brang dang bang mdzod la sogs pa'i nang thams cad phyur bur khengs pas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon pa'i sems can thams cad 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor 'dzad pa med pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa ci nus su bzla'o// thun bsdu ba na/ phyi mchod nang mchod sngar bzhin dang*// bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba ni// gangs can ri ba'i lha gcig pad dkar 'chang*// thugs bskyed gzhan dbang gyur pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyur// skal dman sems can re ba yongs skong ba// mgon po zla ba'i spun zla la phyag 'tshal// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis dgongs gcig tu// dbang rgyas phrin las lhun grub 'khor los sgyur// spyi bor dbang bskur bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// mdzes kyi padma rā ga'i cod paṇa min// smin legs spyan gyi zur mda' 'phangs tsam gyis// skye 'phags yid kyi brtan pa rang dbang du// 'gugs byed dga' ma thugs kar sbas pa la// nor sbyin grangs med kyis btud blta ba snyam// 'di na dkon mchog mchod pa rgyas phyir dang*// chos kyi bshad sgrub dri med ring gnas phyir// ngur smrig 'chang ba grangs med bsdu phyir dang*// chos ldan sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyas phyir dang*// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs bya'i phyir// mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// mkha' 'gro nor sbyin lha yi tshogs dang bcas// bdag cag gus pas bsgrubs kyin mchod byas pas// sgrub po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// tshe dang bsod nams rigs bzang yon tan dang*// stobs 'byor mnga' thang snyan par grags pa'i dbyangs// rin chen 'bru nor lha mi'i longs spyod dpal// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa// dbyar gyi dpal mo dang 'grogs chu gter gyi// ngo mtshar ji bzhin gong nas gong 'phel du// rnam par rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// rigs dang stobs dang 'byor pas mngon rgyags pa'i// skye 'gro'i snying gi brtan pa rab phrogs nas// khab len mthong ba'i lcags phye ji bzhin du// 'di na 'dun pa dbang gi dngos grub stsal// zhes 'dod don gsol lo// 'khor lo'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las skye 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud par byed pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur ces dang*/

bum nang gi 'dod gsol dang 'khor lo'i sngags rnams klog par mos la sngags rnams kyi mthar/ rten 'di gang du bzhugs pa der dge slong gi dge 'dun mang po 'du ba dang stobs 'byor ldan pa'i skye 'gro tham cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ/ zhes brjod la me tog gtor ba mang du bya'o// gsum pa ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis kha bskang ba dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs sogs kyis brtan bzhugs gong ltar brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /myur mdzad mgon po 'grub sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ 'di nyid kyis bkra shis bka' rgya ma'am mi shes na rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs gang rigs kyi bkra shis dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin la sogs pa'i smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ de lta bu'i rim pas rab grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba nas ci nus bar gyi sgrub pa bya'o// sgrub pa zin nas 'khor lo dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang ngam rten bzheng gi nang ngam/ bum pa dang mnyam du 'jog pa'am/ rang gi lus la bcang ba gang rung bya ba dang*/ bum pa ni gang du 'jog pa'i sa der bsgrubs pa yin na der gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas nas sbas pas chog gzhan rten gyi nang ngam gtsug lag khang dang rang gi gnas khang gi mdzod kyi phug sogs la gdan drangs dgos na gyang logs lta bu la gru bzhir brkos pa'am sgam nang lta bu'i logs bzhir sindhū ra'i g.yung drung ris bris pa'i bzhugs gnas su/ bum pa spos dud rol mo dang bcas pas spyan drangs la/ 'og tu ras la padma bris pa'i steng*/ bum pa'i mdun mdzod sgro dang mi 'phrod par bzhag steng du dar gyi gur dang mdun du mar khus sbrus pa'i gtor ma nor bus brgyan pa sngar bzhin bshams/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba dang brtan bzhugs tsam dang bkra shis rgyas par brjod la gzhag go

/gal te bum pa sngar bsgrubs pa zhig yin na/ bum pa bzhag nas mchod gtor bsham pa nas bzung ste/ bdag mdun bskyed bzlas bkra shis kyi bar cho ga thams cad sngar bshad pa bzhin tshar gcig byas na shin tu legs par 'gyur ro// de ltar byas pas skye 'gro mang pos rang la dga' zhing 'dud pa dang*/ g.yang nyams pa gsos shing gnas der chos dang srid pa'i 'byor pa zad mi shes par 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni mi bslu ba nyid do// smras pa/ yid la mngon 'dod gleng mo ci dang ci// tha dad dngos po de dang des 'gengs la// kun rtog rnam dben yid bzhin nor bu zhig /thob pa skal ba'i phul du ma gyur grang*// dge bas chos dang chos ldan sbyin bdag gis// nyer mtshon 'gro ba kun gyi bde legs dpal// 'dzad med rin chen 'byung gnas chen po yi// ngo mtshar gzugs kyi zla bor byed gyur cig /ces mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong nyi ma 'od zer dang nye bar gnas pa kun dga' bsam gtan gyi ngor/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i man ngag yig rnying rnams kyi bcud bsdus te/ nyams su bstar bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba'i rten bzheng skabs su bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
